name: North Europe Systems Atlas
purpose: A sourced cross-domain seed layer connecting countries, European institutions, monetary systems, electricity infrastructure and North Seas energy cooperation. This is an empirical layer; policy interpretations remain separate.

sources.title: Facts and figures on the European Union

records.name: European Union
records.description: Political and economic union of 27 member states with common institutions, law and the single market.

records.name: EU Single Market
records.description: Integration framework supporting free movement of goods, services, capital and people across EU member states.

records.name: Euro Area
records.description: Monetary union of 21 EU member states using the euro in 2026.

records.name: European Central Bank
records.description: Central institution responsible for monetary policy for the euro area through the Eurosystem.

records.name: European Commission
records.description: EU institution responsible for proposing legislation, implementing decisions, upholding EU treaties and managing policy programmes.

records.name: European Parliament
records.description: Directly elected EU institution participating in legislation, budget decisions and democratic oversight.

records.name: Council of the European Union
records.description: EU institution where national ministers represent member-state governments in legislation and policy coordination.

records.name: European Investment Bank
records.description: EU policy bank financing projects supporting EU policy objectives and cross-border investment.

records.name: ENTSO-E
records.description: European Network of Transmission System Operators for Electricity, coordinating interconnected transmission-system operators.

records.name: North Seas Energy Cooperation
records.description: Regional voluntary cooperation framework advancing offshore renewable energy and cross-border electricity infrastructure in the North Seas.

records.name: North Sea
records.description: North European marine region supporting shipping, offshore energy, fisheries, ports and cross-border infrastructure.

records.name: North Sea Offshore Wind System
records.description: Interconnected development field for offshore wind generation, grid connections, industrial supply chains and energy markets.

records.name: European Interconnected Electricity Grid
records.description: Cross-border transmission system coordinated by European transmission system operators, enabling electricity flows between countries.

records.name: Denmark
records.description: EU and North Seas state with a major offshore-wind and electricity-system role.

records.name: Germany
records.description: EU and euro-area member state forming a major industrial, electricity-market and North Seas energy node.

records.name: Netherlands
records.description: EU and euro-area member state with North Sea ports, offshore energy and electricity-system connections.

records.name: Belgium
records.description: EU and euro-area member state with North Sea energy and infrastructure connections.

records.name: France
records.description: EU and euro-area member state participating in North Seas regional energy cooperation.

records.name: Ireland
records.description: EU and euro-area member state participating in North Seas energy cooperation and Atlantic infrastructure systems.

records.name: Norway
records.description: EEA state outside the EU participating in North Seas energy cooperation and the interconnected European energy environment.

records.name: Iceland
records.description: EEA state outside the EU and North Atlantic country participating in North Seas regional energy cooperation.

records.name: United Kingdom
records.description: European state outside the EU participating in the wider North Seas energy cooperation framework.

records.name: Luxembourg
records.description: EU and euro-area member state participating in North Seas regional cooperation.

records.name: Finland
records.description: EU and euro-area northern member state connected to the wider European electricity and monetary systems.

records.name: Sweden
records.description: EU northern member state outside the euro area but integrated into European electricity and single-market systems.

records.name: Poland
records.description: EU member state integrated into the European single market and interconnected electricity system while outside the euro area.

records.name: Ukraine
records.description: European state connected to the wider continental electricity system; ENTSO-E describes the European grid as extending to Ukraine.

records.name: European Energy Security
records.description: System property arising from generation capacity, fuel supply, grids, storage, interconnection, resilience and cross-border coordination.

records.name: European Offshore Wind Industry
records.description: Industrial ecosystem covering turbines, foundations, vessels, cables, ports, engineering, finance and grid connections.

records.name: European Grid Investment
records.description: Investment requirement for expanding, modernising and optimising electricity networks as electrification and variable generation increase.

records.name: Denmark Wind Electricity
records.description: Denmark has a particularly high wind share in its electricity mix among IEA member countries.

records.name: North Seas Renewable Hydrogen
records.description: Emerging cross-border energy-development field linked to offshore renewable generation and regional infrastructure.

coverage_next: country-level electricity capacity and generation observations
quality_rule: A relationship is included only when its endpoint identity and source basis are explicit. No covert, speculative or political-interpretive relationship is promoted into this empirical layer.
